basis: Independent normal-size final direction sheet and ordered frame inspection

directions.reason: Both pupils sit high in the eye surfaces; the centered snout and lifted chin point upward, distinctly above neutral.

Vertical: chin and eye surfaces clearly lift. Horizontal: small rightward facial yaw is subtle at native size and blind review found it ambiguous; progression from 000 to 045 is coherent without reversal.
Horizontal: snout projects right of head center with far eye receding. Vertical: chin is lifted and pupil/eye surfaces aim upward.
Horizontal: stronger rightward snout projection and side face. Vertical: lifted chin and upward eye surface remain above the 090 horizontal pose.
Snout protrudes clearly to screen-right of the round head center; near pupil aims right, far eye is occluded, head is level.
Horizontal: snout and pupils retain a clear rightward aim. Vertical: face pitches down, showing more crown and lowered eye line than 090.
Horizontal: nose/mouth remain displaced to screen-right. Vertical: crown dominates and lowered pupils point toward the lower-right.
Horizontal: face remains slightly right of centered belly and pupils bias right. Vertical: strongly tucked chin and crown exposure clearly aim downward.
Centered head bows straight down; nose is low and both pupils descend toward the feet, with broad crown visible.
Horizontal: snout and face shift left of head center. Vertical: bowed head and low pupils preserve the downward aim.
Horizontal: leftward nose projection and pupil aim. Vertical: face is lowered beneath the broad crown with chin tucked.
Horizontal: clear left-profile snout and pupil. Vertical: snout/eye line sit lower than 270 with a gentle downward pitch.
Snout protrudes to screen-left of head center and near pupil aims left; far eye is occluded and head is level.
Horizontal: snout remains clearly leftward. Vertical: lifted chin and upward eye surface turn gaze above the level-left pose.
Horizontal: leftward facial yaw and pupil aim. Vertical: chin lifts more strongly with eyes aiming high.
Horizontal: leftward nose/face bias remains visible. Vertical: raised chin and high pupils carry the up axis toward 000.

warnings: 022.5 rightward axis is subtle; accepted with coherent ordered-loop evidence.
